### Function
- 「... ~ ...」*possessor marker:* of
- marks the possessor of the preceding noun
- separates a noun from other nouns
### Etymology
#### Glyph
an arrow coming down-right out of an object, showing that it belongs to the next (inspired by sitelen pona for "pi")
#### Sound
- toki pona "pi"
- *a priori:* p=sudden (sprouting out of noun)
